notifications.name: Q20-Plus, Q20-Mini, E26 Pro
notifications.danger: The charger has poor quality connections with fan wires soldered directly to the Printed Circuit Board.Moreover, the creepage and clearance distances between the primary and the secondary circuit of the transformer are insufficient.Additionally, the distance from the live pin to the outside edge is insufficient. The user can touch the accessible live parts and receive an electric shock.Furthermore, the charger and plug can overheat and cause a fire if left unattended. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of two- or three-wheel vehicles and quadricycles.

Prolonged exposure to them through the skin may cause cancer. Moreover, the solders of the product have an excessive concentration of lead and the plastic material of the cable has an excessive concentration of bis(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP) and dibutyl phthalate (DBP) (measured values up to 75%, 2.2 and 0.2 by weight, respectively). Lead poses a risk to the environment, while these phthalates pose a risk to human health and the environment. The product does not comply with the Persistent Organic Pollutants (POP) Regulation nor with the requirements of the Directive on the restriction of the use of certain hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment (RoHS Directive).
